item.title: Fishers’ Organisations in India Demand Recognition From FAO
item.description: India is ranked the second-largest fish-producing nation globally, accounting for around 8 percent of global output. The fisheries sector in India accounts for nearly 7.43 percent of Agricultural Gross Value Added (GVA), the highest (independent) share among the agriculture and allied sectors. item.title: Lebanon: UN warns of growing civilian risks as military activity continues
item.description: Damaged roads, disrupted services and ongoing military activity continue to put civilians at risk in south Lebanon as strikes between Israeli forces and Hezbollah continue, according to the UN’s peacekeeping mission in the country (UNIFIL).

item.title: Security Council LIVE: Tracking Syria’s transition
item.description: As Damascus continues to rebuild after more than a decade of war – from the recent dissolution of the Kurdish-led Syrian Democratic Forces to the United States’ removal of Syria from its sponsors of terrorism list – a top UN official warned the Security Council on Thursday that international support can help tackle outstanding challenges. item.title: Shock and devastation remain, a day after Himalayan flood disaster
item.description: Amid reports that hundreds of people are still missing in Nepal and China after a floodwater surge slammed into towns and villages on Wednesday, aid teams have been working to reach communities cut off by the disaster.

item.title: Aid reaches hundreds of thousands in Gaza amid severe food insecurity
item.description: As hunger deepens across Gaza, humanitarian agencies continue to deliver food and other essential supplies to families in need.

item.title: After Israeli seizure of Kalandia training centre, UNRWA warns of impact on youth
item.description: The seizure of a vocational training centre in occupied East Jerusalem has left hundreds of Palestinian young people without access to skills and training that could help shape their futures.

item.title: UN chief condemns “indifference” as Ebola cases mount in DR Congo
item.description: The Ebola Bundibugyo outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) requires “urgent” action and funding to rein in its alarming spread, the UN Secretary-General told reporters at UN Headquarters on Thursday.

item.title: UN Secretary General Expresses Sadness Over Lives Lost in Nepal-Tibet Flash Floods
